description: Since the 2026-10-30 docs, Cloudflare's docs build shows this result as `unknown`: builds_APIResponse.result became `object or array of object`, and the docs show that wrapper type in place of the operation's own result type. The API did not change. Cloudflare's OpenAPI (cloudflare/api-schemas) still types PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/builds/triggers/{trigger_uuid}/environment_variables result as builds_EnvironmentVariablesResponse, the map listTriggersEnvironmentVariables returns. Shapes restored from the docs as mirrored on 2026-10-29 (spec-mirror-cloudflare ff4dc733).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Whether to hide the value after it is saved. Secret values remain available to builds but appear as `null` when you list variables; non-secret values remain visible.
Value is null for secret environment variables
